statusDetail: Recon could not reach the target experience. Akamai edge protection returned an Access Denied document instead of the Lowe’s site to the raw-CDP Chrome session (reference IDs varied by request). The target content and representative journeys were therefore unavailable. Per the audit method, the run stopped rather than judging the edge error page as the site.

page.notes: The target application profile could not be established because only an Akamai Access Denied response was available.
